name: Convergence of the Flint Hills and Cookson Hills series
informal:
The Flint Hills series summing $csc(n)^2 / n^3$ from $n=1$ to $\infty$ converges.
(Note that we 0-index the series below.)

references.label: Alekseyev, On the Flint Hills series
